label: Same profile witness weak-bridge sibling omission controls
paraphrase: Closed mathematical controls, actual world false, universal two-world frame: (1) one concrete most-real individual existing at both worlds that supports itself only at the other world satisfies every input of the weak-bridge sibling except no novel necessary support, and its exemplar is not underived; (2) a necessary concrete most-real individual supported at the other world by a contingent individual satisfies every input except no contingent ground of the necessary (no novel necessary support holds vacuously), and its exemplar is not underived. Assignments only, not evidence against either bridge.
